      artifact ∈ out →
        artifact.stage ∈ MAT010.Archive.stages ∧
          MAT010.Archive.validName artifact.name = true ∧
            MAT010.Archive.validDigest artifact.sha256 = true ∧
              (MAT010.Archive.hasMidiSuffix artifact.name = true → artifact.stage = MAT010.Archive.firstStage) ∧
